editorial.blurb: A beloved family-owned Mexican spot where fresh, flavorful dishes and genuinely warm service keep people coming back for years.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit up $2 Taco Tuesday for an unbeatable value on tacos with onion and cilantro, and don't skip the fresh chips and salsa to start.

topDishes.note: Flavorful and satisfying—reviewers scraped their plates
Fresh and tasty, especially on $2 Taco Tuesday with steak, chicken, chorizo, or pork
